name: dokan_e2e_api_automation_playwright
description: dokan e2e & api endpoints test automation using playwright

scripts.docker:start: npm run start:env && npm run sync:admin
scripts.sync:admin: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {execSync} = require('child_process'); const user = process.env.ADMIN || 'admin'; const pass = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'password'; const email = user + '@example.com'; console.log('Syncing admin user:', user); let newUserId = 2; try { const result = execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user create ' + user + ' ' + email + ' --role=administrator --user_pass=' + pass + ' --porcelain', {encoding: 'utf8'}); newUserId = result.trim().split('\n').pop().trim(); console.log('✅ Admin user created! ID:', newUserId); } catch(e) { console.log('User exists, updating password...'); try { const result = execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user get ' + user + ' --field=ID', {encoding: 'utf8'}); newUserId = result.trim(); execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user update ' + user + ' --user_pass=' + pass + ' --skip-email', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('✅ Admin password updated!'); } catch(e2) { console.log('⚠️ Admin sync had issues'); } } try { execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- bash -c \"wp post list --post_type=page,post --author=1 --format=ids | xargs -r wp post update --post_author=' + newUserId + '\"', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('✅ Reassigned pages/posts to new admin'); execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user delete admin --yes 2>/dev/null', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('✅ Default admin removed'); } catch(e) { console.log('Default admin already removed or pages already reassigned'); }"
scripts.restore:pages: npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- bash -c "wp post list --post_type=page --post_status=trash --format=ids | xargs -r -I {} wp post update {} --post_status=publish --post_author=2"
scripts._comment_docker_setup: === Docker Setup Scripts (Run Once After Docker Start) ===
scripts.docker:reset: npm run reset:db && npm run docker:setup
scripts.site:reset: NO_SETUP=false npm run site:setup && npm run env:setup
